# Family Locksmith

> Family Locksmith is a family-run, fully insured emergency locksmith service in the United Kingdom, available 24 hours a day. Typical response time is around 25 minutes. Engineers are DBS-checked and work is backed by a 12-month guarantee on parts and workmanship.

## Services
- [Emergency lockout](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/emergency-lockout.html): Non-destructive entry for homes, flats and communal doors, day or night.
- [uPVC and composite door locks](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/upvc-composite-doors.html): Multipoint gearbox failures, handles that will not lift, keys that will not turn.
- [Lock changes and repairs](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/lock-changes-repairs.html): Cylinder changes, re-keying, British Standard BS3621 locks.
- [Burglary and break-in repair](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/burglary-repair.html): Securing the property, boarding up, permanent repair after insurer contact.
- [Security upgrades](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/security-upgrades.html): Anti-snap cylinders, TS007 three star, insurance-specification work.
- [Commercial locksmith](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/commercial-locksmith.html): Shops, offices, roller shutters, master-key suites.
- [Landlord and letting agent services](https://familylocksmith.co.uk/landlord-services.html): Cylinder changes between tenancies, keyed alike, invoiced to the agency.

## Key facts
- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including nights, weekends and bank holidays.
- Typical response time: approximately 25 minutes.
- Entry method: non-destructive picking or bypass wherever possible, so the existing lock is retained.
- Credentials: fully insured, DBS-checked engineers, 12-month guarantee on parts and workmanship.
- Lock standards fitted: British Standard BS3621 and TS007 three star, meeting most UK home insurance requirements.
